newsitem.title: POLAND: POLISH AWS TO DISCLOSE BALLOT LISTS BY MID-JULY.
newsitem.headline: POLISH AWS TO DISCLOSE BALLOT LISTS BY MID-JULY.

text.p: Solidarity Election Action (AWS), which groups more than 30 small right-wing Polish opposition parties, will disclose its ballot-lists in mid-July for the September general elections, its spokesman said on Thursday.
"The lists should appear soon -- we are closer to the end than to the beginning of this process. It should be completed by the middle of July," Tomasz Tywonek told a news conference.

AWS, grouped around the Solidarity trade union, is the strongest rival in the September 21 polls to the main party in the present ruling coalition, the Democratic Left Alliance (SLD) of former communists.

A committee of AWS leaders has been working for weeks on drafting the lists, which have aroused strains within the opposition grouping as its member parties compete for the best places near the top of ballot papers.
Some parties have complained that the trade union may be reserving too many good places for its own members.

Tywonek said the AWS would include candidates who are not politicians but are experts in matters vital to the working of parliament and the country, on its so-called national list which is being prepared alongside regional ballot lists.
"There will be economists, there will be lawyers, there will be representatives of regional governments," Tywonek said.
But Tywonek said the AWS would not exclude leaders of its member parties from this national list.

He also said that no-one on the national list would also have the coveted top place on any local list except for the AWS leader Marian Krzaklewski, who is also head of the trade union. -- Warsaw Newsroom +48 22 653 9700
